flags.accepted_alternatives_need_sentence_revi: Review already accepted alternate whole-sentence naturalness and whether it demonstrates the target grammar.

flags.possible_noun_connector_or_recipient_var: Check noun's final consonant, relationship and formal/casual nuance.
flags.possible_tense_register_aspect_near_miss: Identify whether prompts require a tense/register/aspect and provide differentiated near-miss feedback.

existingVariantReview.educatorQuestion: 마셔요 and the longer 마시어요 can express the same action; check if both are standard and usable in this review's register.
학교로 가요 is natural, but 로 stresses direction while 에 gives a destination. Assess target-grammar mastery separately.
회사로 가요 conveys direction toward the company, not always identical to company as destination.
공원으로 가요 is a directional reading, acceptable in many contexts; verify prompt and whether target 에 was demonstrated.
가게로 가요 is natural with directional emphasis. Different grammar may be acceptable without proving the target particle.

existingVariantReview.educatorQuestion: 아래 and 밑 can both describe a cat under a chair; their ordinary usage is not identical in every spatial setting.
수업 다음에 is plausible, but idiomaticity can vary; compare 수업 후에 and 수업이 끝난 다음에.

queue.englishHint: I meet a friend after work.

existingVariantReview.educatorQuestion: 퇴근 다음에 may sound less idiomatic than 퇴근 후에 or 퇴근한 다음에. Request native usage judgment before retaining an accepted answer.

queue.englishHint: I take a walk after dinner.

existingVariantReview.educatorQuestion: 저녁 식사 다음에 is possible but can be less idiomatic than 저녁 식사 후에; review as a whole sentence.
과 and 이랑 can both join the nouns 빵 and 우유; differing written/spoken style should be explained after review.
와 and 랑 can both mark the companion 친구 in this sentence; prefer a nuance label, not a false error.
과 and 이랑 agree with consonant-ending 빵; both express joining nouns here.
와 and 랑 agree with vowel-ending 우유; the difference is mainly style/context in this sentence.

지요 and contracted 죠 express the same confirmation-ending family.
